STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast plate with a split English muffin (or similar bread half) topped with a soft white cheese or egg-white-like spread, plus scrambled eggs (white, cooked) and browned breakfast potato cubes. Photographed from above at a slight angle.

STEP 2 - Ruler: A square-ish white dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 × (13)² ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Scrambled egg (white/pale, cooked)
- Breakfast potato cubes (pan-fried, browned)
- Split English muffin half with white spread (cream cheese-like)

STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate):
- Scrambled egg: ~14% (about 74 cm²)
- Potato cubes: ~12% (about 64 cm²)
- Muffin half with spread: ~13% (about 69 cm²)
Total covered ≈ 39% of plate.

STEP 5 - Volume (area × height):
- Scrambled egg: 74 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 111 ml
- Potato cubes: 64 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 96 ml
- Muffin with spread: 69 cm² × 1.0 cm ≈ 69 ml (muffin half is thin, spread adds height)

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Egg: 111 ml × 0.95 ≈ 105 g
- Potatoes: 96 ml × 0.6 ≈ 58 g
- Muffin + spread: 69 ml × 0.7 (bread with soft spread, lower density than dense items) ≈ 48 g. Split into muffin ~30 g and spread ~18 g.

STEP 7 - Energy (kcal/100 g, as plated):
- Scrambled egg (cooked, with some butter/oil): ~150 kcal/100 g → 105 g ≈ 158 kcal
- Fried potato cubes: ~150 kcal/100 g → 58 g ≈ 87 kcal
- English muffin: ~240 kcal/100 g → 30 g ≈ 72 kcal
- Cream cheese-style spread: ~300 kcal/100 g → 18 g ≈ 54 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 211 g, about 370 kcal. This is plausible for one breakfast plate with a partly covered dinner plate; the visible portions are modest, so the estimate stays in that range.
